text:
elaine_sales: Quick sync — customer (FinOps startup) raised a POC question: do we collect model telemetry that contains customer prompts/responses? They want clarity on: 1) what telemetry is enabled by default for Hosted API, 2) retention periods, 3) can we disable it for the POC or restrict to Dedicated/Private, and 4) does this affect pricing/caching. Need an answer for tomorrow. @raj_security @maria_privacy

raj_security: Short answer: by default we capture request/response metadata + anonymized telemetry (latency, status codes, token counts, model version). We do NOT persist full request/response bodies for training. That said, we retain request/response bodies in a short-term abuse detection store — will confirm retention window. For Dedicated/Private the telemetry export can be turned off more tightly.

maria_privacy: Heads up — prompts can include personal data, so GDPR applies. DSARs/deletions could include request bodies if they contain personal data. For Hosted API, our DPA + SCCs currently cover standard retention; for bespoke retention windows or zero-retention for a POC we should sign a short addendum.

devon_se: There is a console toggle in beta: `telemetry.collection.enabled = false`. Example config we use in internal docs: ```telemetry: { collection: false, retention_days: 0 }``` Not 100% sure that this prevents the short-term audit log capture; @raj_security?

raj_security: Confirming: the console toggle stops export to analytics pipelines and disables aggregation features. However, short-lived audit logs (48h) are still captured for incident investigation and rate-limit abuse detection. We can redact request/response bodies before export and can reduce the abuse-store retention for a POC (e.g., 7 days). Important: we never use customer request/response bodies for model training.

maria_privacy: For messaging to the customer — be explicit: 1) what's collected by default, 2) how to disable for POC, 3) retention windows and deletion/DSAR process, and 4) what contractual language to expect (DPA + optional addendum). Also clarify if telemetry contains any third-party transfers.

devon_se: Operational note: disabling telemetry reduces our ability to do prefix caching and some smart-routing optimizations (we rely on aggregate request patterns). That can increase per-token cost in some workloads because caching/aggregations drive fewer cache hits. It's not a line-item price increase but a potential efficiency hit — flag to finance/sales.

elaine_sales: Great — can we get a one-pager to send to the customer with bullets: what's collected, how to disable for POC, retention and DSAR/deletion steps, and commercial impacts? Also confirm whether 'telemetry off' needs a signed addendum for the POC. Meeting is tomorrow 10:00am PST.

raj_security: I'll draft the one-pager. Key bullets I'll include: - Default telemetry: latency, token counts, error/status codes, model version, per-route metrics. - Request/response bodies: kept in abuse-detection store for 30 days by default (can reduce to 7 days for POC on request). - We do not use request/response bodies for training. - Toggle: `telemetry.collection=false` stops analytics export; audit logs retained 48h. - Contract: addendum required for nonstandard retention or absolute zero retention.

maria_privacy: I'll add the DSAR/deletion workflow and suggested privacy language snippets for the DPA addendum (e.g., "Redwood will not use Customer data for model training; request/response bodies are retained only for abuse detection and will be deleted on request per the retention schedule").

devon_se: I'll pull a short config snippet and console path: Console → Project → Settings → Telemetry → Disable. Also note: for Dedicated we'll need engineering lead time to ensure telemetry pipelines are off-by-default for the customer's reserved capacity.

elaine_sales: ETA? Customer expects an answer in the meeting.

raj_security: Draft ready by EOD today. Creating an ops ticket to change retention for the POC window. @ops-bot please open.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-12345 — telemetry-retention-change (assignee: infra-oncall).

maria_privacy: :thumbsup:

elaine_sales: Thanks everyone — will hold on the customer meeting note until I have the doc.
